text.en: CVE-2026-110930, published in NVD on 5 November 2026, affects Codex Desktop for Windows: quotation marks in Explorer project paths can add startup arguments that run code before sign-in.
text.es: CVE-2026-110930, publicado en NVD el 5 de noviembre de 2026, afecta a Codex Desktop para Windows: las comillas en rutas de proyecto del Explorador pueden añadir argumentos de arranque que ejecutan código antes de iniciar sesión.
text.ca: CVE-2026-110930, publicat a NVD el 5 de novembre de 2026, afecta Codex Desktop per a Windows: les cometes en camins de projecte de l'Explorador poden afegir arguments d'arrencada que executen codi abans d'iniciar sessió.

text.en: CVE-2026-111771, published in NVD on 5 November 2026, affects @modelcontextprotocol/sdk from 1.6.0 before 1.32.0: its server-side bearer authentication did not check the token audience.
text.es: CVE-2026-111771, publicado en NVD el 5 de noviembre de 2026, afecta a @modelcontextprotocol/sdk desde 1.6.0 hasta antes de 1.32.0: su autenticación bearer del lado del servidor no comprobaba la audiencia del token.
text.ca: CVE-2026-111771, publicat a NVD el 5 de novembre de 2026, afecta @modelcontextprotocol/sdk des de 1.6.0 fins abans de 1.32.0: la seva autenticació bearer del costat del servidor no comprovava l'audiència del token.

text.en: CVE-2026-111769, published in NVD on 5 November 2026, affects @modelcontextprotocol/sdk before 1.32.0: its client transports and OAuth requests kept custom headers when following redirects to another origin.
text.es: CVE-2026-111769, publicado en NVD el 5 de noviembre de 2026, afecta a @modelcontextprotocol/sdk antes de 1.32.0: sus transportes de cliente y peticiones OAuth conservaban las cabeceras propias al seguir redirecciones a otro origen.
text.ca: CVE-2026-111769, publicat a NVD el 5 de novembre de 2026, afecta @modelcontextprotocol/sdk abans de 1.32.0: els seus transports de client i peticions OAuth conservaven les capçaleres pròpies en seguir redireccions a un altre origen.

text.en: CVE-2026-123272, published in NVD on 5 November 2026, affects mcp-go before 1.2.1: an MCP server can declare another resource in its OAuth metadata and obtain tokens for it.
text.es: CVE-2026-123272, publicado en NVD el 5 de noviembre de 2026, afecta a mcp-go antes de 1.2.1: un servidor MCP puede declarar otro recurso en sus metadatos OAuth y obtener tokens para él.
text.ca: CVE-2026-123272, publicat a NVD el 5 de novembre de 2026, afecta mcp-go abans de 1.2.1: un servidor MCP pot declarar un altre recurs a les seves metadades OAuth i obtenir-ne tokens.

text.en: OSV published MAL-2026-18705 and MAL-2026-18706 on 5 November 2026, listing the PyPI packages teamviewer-mcp-server and mcp-teamviewer as containing malicious code.
text.es: OSV publicó MAL-2026-18705 y MAL-2026-18706 el 5 de noviembre de 2026, que clasifican los paquetes PyPI teamviewer-mcp-server y mcp-teamviewer como código malicioso.
text.ca: OSV va publicar MAL-2026-18705 i MAL-2026-18706 el 5 de novembre de 2026, que classifiquen els paquets PyPI teamviewer-mcp-server i mcp-teamviewer com a codi maliciós.

held.text_en: CVE-2026-111770, published in NVD on 5 November 2026, affects @modelcontextprotocol/server from 2.0.0 before 2.3.0: a shared stateless transport could send responses to the wrong client.
CVE-2026-123271, published in NVD on 5 November 2026, affects ChatCLI before v1.215.2: its MCP OAuth login accepts a resource indicator supplied by the server.
CVE-2026-54140, published in NVD on 5 November 2026, affects OpenHuman before 0.57.13: MCP tool descriptions enter the model context without neutralizing instructions.
CVE-2026-123022, published in NVD on 5 November 2026, affects AgentScope up to 2.0.11: OS command injection in its MCP Workspace API.
CVE-2026-77604, published in NVD on 5 November 2026, affects Code Graph RAG before 0.0.345: its MCP read_file can read outside the project root.
CVE-2026-87008, published in NVD on 5 November 2026, affects Code Graph RAG before 0.0.589: symbolic links let structural_search reach files outside the root.
CVE-2026-102943, published in NVD on 5 November 2026, affects Dagu before 2.11.0: its MCP dagu_read reads YAML files outside the DAG directories.
Google Antigravity CLI 1.5.1, dated 5 November 2026, hardens plugin OAuth token protection in the sandbox, according to its changelog.
OpenClaw 2026.11.1, dated 5 November 2026: failed Mac config saves no longer overwrite secrets, according to its release notes.
GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.106, dated 5 November 2026, adds COPILOT_SESSION_CWD for launching and expanding local MCP server configs.
